hero.title: Operational Efficiency
hero.subtitle2: Streamline processes and satisfy customers using location intelligence

intro.title: Create smarter workflows
intro.paragraph: Many organizations struggle to develop strategic and practical plans for operational efficiency. Business leaders can use location intelligence to quickly manage and streamline hundreds of projects. Smart maps, analysis, and dashboards give real-time views of multiple locations and help identify business processes that need improvement. Harnessing authoritative data reduces errors while boosting productivity and reducing costs.

opportunities.title: See your operations optimized
opportunities.intro: A real-time operational view of people, assets, and events reveals the big picture and areas of critical focus. This drives better task management, synergy, customer satisfaction, and competitive advantage.
bullets: Collaborate and share real-time intelligence securely via maps, apps, dashboards, and reports.
Adopt modern workflows that eliminate wasted time and resources.
Combine multiple activity streams and processes into a unified workflow.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.blurb: Optimize operations and enhance efficiency using location-driven insights from the Esri Geospatial Cloud.

items.title: Real-Time Visualization and Analytics
items.body: Know where dangers exist right now across your community or business and monitor changing situations. Use big data and Internet of Things (IoT) technology to make quick, informed decisions based on the most up-to-date information.

items.title: Field Operations
items.body: Improve coordination and operational efficiency in workforce activities. Reduce or even replace paper reliance, modernize workflows, adopt data-driven decision-making, and harness the power of location intelligence.

items.title: Mapping
items.body: Visualize people, places, and assets to gain a clear understanding of threats. See what's happening across the organization, create robust safety plans, and know where to allocate resources.

items.title: Asset Tracking and Analysis
items.body: Visualize moving and fixed assets dynamically. Implement problem-solving tools to accurately record the locations and health of your assets.

items.title: Real-Time Location Tracking
items.body: Gain insights from your data whether you are tracking moving assets or stationary sensors. Make the right decision at the right time.

items.title: Field Service Management
items.body: Digitally transform the approach to field operations. Gain efficiency from real-time data updates and integrate mobile field apps into workflows.

items.title: Big Data Keeps the Lights On
items.excerpt: The North American Grid must work together to keep the lights on throughout the United States and parts of Canada and Mexico.

items.title: LI Saves Geneva Airport Millions
items.excerpt: A small airport with big operations had to expand its operational efficiency to keep up with high demand.

items.title: Tracing Each Oyster from Tide to Table
items.excerpt: Taylor Shellfish Farms improved the resilience of the shellfish it raised. This required complete digital transformation and adaptability.
